fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Fair arrivals supply 198 coins and trust is set to 45. After each arrival, the clock resets to remove the arrival-only prayer misses. The real player is placed at the named market marker and the real clock is set to the named state with unplayed prayer windows excluded. For n08, a fresh arrival leaves Suhoor at zero; the actual tarawih button adds one night. A clock skip excludes the earlier Isha at 04:45 on 2 Ramadan, then normal time passes to 21:00 on 3 Ramadan to accrue nine misses. No rendered words or Ramadan/prayer counts are seeded.
method: Native Godot viewport. Real viewport clicks drive fair arrivals, Ramadan actions, the Iftar panel and both prayer record views.
settled_toasts: The visible action toasts are checked against locked data immediately, then n02 and n07 capture the map after the ordinary toast timer expires.
